    Your team

    Patient first.

    Stefan Yakel, DO

    Orthopedic spine surgeon

    Dr. Yakel starts with a simple question: what is really causing your pain? From there he builds a focused plan designed to use as little surgery as possible, and often none at all. He trained in orthopedics in Corvallis, Oregon, then completed a spine fellowship at Twin Cities Spine Center in Minneapolis, with a special interest in minimally invasive techniques. At Premier Spine he puts patients first, listens closely, and explains every option. Away from the clinic, he enjoys skiing and time on the water with his family.

    Often this results in no surgical intervention at all.

    From the Premier Spine About page
    Read full bio

    Dr. Stefan Yakel is a board-certified orthopedic surgeon who focuses on the spine. At Premier Spine in Coeur d’Alene, his approach begins with listening. He works to isolate the true cause of a patient’s pain, then recommends a targeted plan that uses as little surgery as possible. For many patients, that means no surgery at all.

    Dr. Yakel earned his Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine at Midwestern University. He completed his orthopedic residency in Corvallis, Oregon, where his interest in minimally invasive spine techniques took hold, and then a spine fellowship at Twin Cities Spine Center in Minneapolis, Minnesota. He has published research on adult spinal deformity in the European Spine Journal.

    His practice covers a wide range of neck and back conditions, including spinal stenosis, deformity, SI joint problems, vertebral compression fractures, and spinal trauma. He offers minimally invasive and robotic spine surgery, and he also treats nerve compression at the wrist and elbow, such as carpal and cubital tunnel syndrome. Every recommendation is shared openly. He believes patients know their own bodies best, and the final decision is always theirs.

    Dr. Yakel is affiliated with area hospitals including Bonner General Health and Northwest Specialty Hospital. Outside the clinic, he stays active with snow skiing and water sports in North Idaho.

    Sarah Frank, APRN

    AGACNP, CPNP · Nurse practitioner

    Sarah Frank is a nurse practitioner who brings years of hands-on care to Premier Spine. Her path, from emergency room and ICU nursing to flight nursing and family practice, taught her to stay calm and listen closely. Today she performs thorough musculoskeletal assessments, reviews imaging, and works alongside Dr. Yakel to shape each patient’s plan, from conservative therapy to surgery. She is known for clear education and a personal approach. Outside the clinic, Sarah enjoys wake surfing, exploring Coeur d’Alene with her family, and staying active.

    I enjoy helping people figure out their spine issues and find them conservative solutions to get back to their quality of life!

    Sarah Frank, APRN
    Read full bio

    Sarah Frank, APRN, is a nurse practitioner at Premier Spine. Her career began in nursing in Illinois, and she later worked in California and Wyoming. Along the way she served in the emergency room and ICU and as a flight nurse with Wyoming Life Flight, and she has experience in family practice. That acute-care background shapes how she works today: steady, observant, and thorough.

    Sarah earned her Master of Nursing from Walden University, specializing in adult-gerontology acute care, and a post-master’s certificate in pediatric primary care from Maryville University.

    At Premier Spine, Sarah performs in-depth musculoskeletal assessments, reviews X-rays, MRIs, and CT scans, and collaborates with Dr. Yakel to guide care, whether that means conservative therapy or surgical options. She tailors treatment plans, including functional movement and strength training, and she takes the time to educate patients so they can manage acute and chronic conditions with confidence. In the operating room, she assists Dr. Yakel, and she says one of her favorite parts of the work is seeing patients do well after surgery.

    Sarah lives in Coeur d’Alene. She enjoys the outdoors and wake surfing, and is an avid fitness enthusiast who enjoys eating well and staying healthy.

    Quick answers

    Before you call.

    Do I need a referral?

    No. A referral is not necessary to schedule a consultation at Premier Spine. Call the office at (208) 770-3536 to get started.

    Do I need surgery?

    Not necessarily. Dr. Yakel’s approach often results in no surgery. After your evaluation we will explain what we find, what the options are, and whether surgery is something to consider.

    Do you accept my insurance?

    Please call the office at (208) 770-3536 and our team will help you verify your insurance coverage.

    Security & privacy

    Plain language, honest status.

    Status: in design. To be implemented before any real data. This demo has no login, no patient data, and sends nothing.

    • HIPAA-compliant hosting & BAAs

      Hosted on a cloud with a signed BAA. Every vendor that touches patient data signs one too.

      In design

    • Encryption

      Encrypted in transit and at rest, with keys we control.

      In design

    • Role-based access

      Patients, staff and physicians see only what their role needs.

      In design

    • Audit logs

      Every view, AI draft, edit and approval is recorded: who, what, when.

      In design

    • SSO & MFA

      Sign in through the practice’s identity provider, with a second factor.

      In design

    • Minimum necessary

      Each screen and each AI request gets only the data it needs.

      In design

    • Human approval on everything clinical

      AI drafts. A person approves. Nothing is sent on its own.

      In design

    • AI vendor BAA, no training on PHI

      AI runs only through a BAA-covered provider, with no training on your data.

      In design

    • Data retention

      Keep what the law and the practice require. Delete the rest on a schedule.

      In design

    • Incident response

      A written plan: detect, contain, notify, learn.

      In design

    This is a product plan, not legal advice. A healthcare compliance attorney should review it before launch.
